mapper.sql: ca.id, ca.user_id, ca.status, ca.id_card_no, ca.id_card_front, ca.id_card_back, ca.id_card_hold, ca.vehicle_type, ca.vehicle_plate, ca.vehicle_photo, ca.driver_license_no, ca.driver_license_photo, ca.vehicle_license_no, ca.vehicle_license_photo, ca.emergency_contact_name, ca.emergency_contact_phone, ca.emergency_contact_relation, ca.work_city, ca.work_district, ca.review_time, ca.reviewer_id, ca.reject_reason, ca.remark, ca.create_time, ca.update_time
u.name as user_name, u.phone as user_phone, u.username as user_username
mapper.select: SELECT , FROM courier_applications ca LEFT JOIN users u ON ca.user_id = u.id WHERE ca.id = #{id}
SELECT , FROM courier_applications ca LEFT JOIN users u ON ca.user_id = u.id WHERE ca.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ca.create_time DESC
SELECT , FROM courier_applications ca LEFT JOIN users u ON ca.user_id = u.id WHERE u.phone = #{phone} ORDER BY ca.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT , FROM courier_applications ca LEFT JOIN users u ON ca.user_id = u.id WHERE ca.status = #{status} ORDER BY ca.create_time DESC
SELECT , FROM courier_applications ca LEFT JOIN users u ON ca.user_id = u.id WHERE ca.status = 'pending' ORDER BY ca.create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO courier_applications ( user_id, status, id_card_no, id_card_front, id_card_back, id_card_hold, vehicle_type, vehicle_plate, vehicle_photo, driver_license_no, driver_license_photo, vehicle_license_no, vehicle_license_photo, emergency_contact_name, emergency_contact_phone, emergency_contact_relation, work_city, work_district, remark, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{status}, #{idCardNo}, #{idCardFront}, #{idCardBack}, #{idCardHold}, #{vehicleType}, #{vehiclePlate}, #{vehiclePhoto}, #{driverLicenseNo}, #{driverLicensePhoto}, #{vehicleLicenseNo}, #{vehicleLicensePhoto}, #{emergencyContactName}, #{emergencyContactPhone}, #{emergencyContactRelation}, #{workCity}, #{workDistrict}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE courier_applications SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, review_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
